about_zh: 从模型到智能体，本仓库里最密集的一块。

repos.description: Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 是一款个人 AI 助手，支持在 WhatsApp、Telegram、Slack 等主流通讯平台运行，兼容 macOS/iOS/Android 系统，具备语音交互与实时画布渲染能力。其网关为控制平面，核心产品是本地部署的个性化助手，强调隐私、速度与持续在线体验。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that runs on your own devices across any OS and platform. It integrates with messaging apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Slack, supports voice interaction, live canvas rendering, and prioritizes local deployment for privacy, speed, and always-on personal assistance.

repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.summary_zh: Superpowers 是一个面向编码智能体的完整软件开发工作流框架，基于可组合的'技能'和初始指令，确保智能体高效协作。它通过自动触发技能（如需求澄清、设计评审、TDD开发计划生成、子智能体驱动开发），实现从构思到交付的无缝流程，强调 YAGNI、DRY 和测试优先原则，适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等主流 AI 编程平台。
repos.summary_en: Superpowers is an agentic software development framework built on composable 'skills' that guide coding agents through a complete workflow—from idea refinement and design validation to TDD-driven implementation via subagent-driven development. It automates planning, branching, testing, and execution across platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, enforcing best practices like YAGNI, DRY, and red/green testing.

repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 公开 Claude 智能体技能库，提供文档处理、开发工具、企业工作流等多样化技能模板，支持动态加载与自定义扩展，助力 AI 智能体实现专业化任务自动化。
repos.summary_en: Anthropic's public repository for Agent Skills provides Claude with dynamic, modular capabilities across document processing, development tools, and enterprise workflows, enabling specialized task automation through customizable, production-grade skill modules.

repos.description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
repos.summary_zh: n8n 是一款面向技术团队的安全工作流自动化平台，融合可视化拖拽与自定义代码（JavaScript/Python），支持 400+ 集成和原生 AI 能力（基于 LangChain），提供自托管或云端部署选项，采用公平源代码许可，确保数据控制与可定制性。
repos.summary_en: n8n is a secure workflow automation platform combining visual building with custom code (JavaScript/Python), offering 400+ integrations, native AI capabilities via LangChain, and flexible deployment options—self-hosted or cloud—under a fair-code license for full data control and extensibility.

repos.description: f.k.a. Awesome ChatGPT Prompts. Share, discover, and collect prompts from the community. Free and open source — self-host for your organization with complete privacy.
repos.summary_zh: prompts.chat 是全球最大的开源提示词库，涵盖 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等主流 AI 模型。提供社区驱动的提示词分享与收集平台，支持免费使用及私有化部署，兼具学术引用价值与工业级实用性。
repos.summary_en: Prompts.chat is the world's largest open-source prompt library for AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It offers a community-driven platform to share, discover, and collect prompts, with free public access and self-hosting options for organizations seeking privacy.

repos.description: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
repos.summary_zh: Dify 是一个生产就绪的 AI 智能体工作流开发平台，支持可视化编排、多模型集成与自动化流程构建，适用于企业级应用开发与 AI 能力快速集成场景。
repos.summary_en: Dify is a production-ready platform for agentic workflow development, enabling visual orchestration, multi-model integration, and automated process building for enterprise AI application development.

repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

repos.description: Langflow is a powerful tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows.
repos.summary_zh: Langflow 是一个强大的 AI 智能体与工作流构建平台，提供可视化拖拽界面和 Python 源码级定制能力。支持多智能体编排、API/MCP 部署、LangSmith 可观测性集成，内置主流 LLM 与向量数据库支持，适用于企业级 AI 应用快速开发与部署。
repos.summary_en: Langflow is a powerful platform for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows. It offers a visual builder interface, source code customization in Python, multi-agent orchestration, API/MCP deployment, LangSmith observability, and native support for major LLMs and vector databases, making it ideal for rapid enterprise-grade AI application development.

repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台桌面一体化助手工具，支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的统一管理，提供便捷的 AI 编程助手集成与配置，适用于多模型协作开发场景。
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform desktop all-in-one assistant tool for managing Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, enabling unified configuration and integration of multiple AI coding assistants for streamlined development workflows.

repos.description: The agent engineering platform.
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 是一个构建可靠 AI 智能体的框架，提供标准化的 LLM、嵌入、向量存储等组件接口，支持实时数据增强、模型互操作性和快速原型开发，助力开发者高效构建生产级 LLM 应用。
repos.summary_en: LangChain is a framework for building reliable AI agents and LLM-powered applications. It offers standardized interfaces for models, embeddings, and vector stores, enabling real-time data augmentation, model interoperability, and rapid prototyping for production-ready AI solutions.

repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了30,000+行关于主流AI编程工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Devin AI等）的系统提示、内部工具和模型架构的深度解析，涵盖其设计理念、功能实现与技术细节，为开发者提供全面的AI编程助手技术洞察与最佳实践参考。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains over 30,000 lines of insights into system prompts, internal tools, and AI models of major AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Devin AI), offering deep technical analysis of their architecture, functionality, and design principles for developers seeking to understand and leverage AI-powered development tools.

repos.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
repos.summary_zh: gstack 是 Garry Tan（YC 创始人）基于 Claude Code 构建的 AI 工程团队工具集，集成 CEO、设计师、工程师、发布经理等 15 个角色，通过 slash 命令实现产品规划、代码审查、QA 测试、安全审计和自动化部署。支持每日 1-2 万行代码的高效开发，适用于技术型创始人、Claude Code 新手及资深技术负责人。
repos.summary_en: gstack is Garry Tan's (YC President) AI-powered engineering toolkit built on Claude Code, featuring 15 specialized roles including CEO, designer, eng manager, and QA. It enables ultra-high productivity coding through slash commands for planning, review, testing, security audits, and deployment—ideal for technical founders, Claude Code beginners, and senior tech leads.

repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface.
repos.summary_zh: ComfyUI 是一款功能强大的模块化扩散模型 GUI 工具，采用节点/流程图界面设计，支持复杂 Stable Diffusion 工作流的图形化编排。它提供无代码可视化操作，兼容 SD1.x/SD2.x/SDXL/SD3/Flux 等多种模型，支持 NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Apple Silicon 等全平台 GPU，适用于图像生成、视频处理、AI 艺术创作等场景。
repos.summary_en: ComfyUI is a powerful modular GUI for diffusion models featuring a node-based graph interface for building complex Stable Diffusion pipelines without coding. It supports multiple models including SD1.x, SDXL, SD3, Flux, and PixArt, runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS with full GPU support across NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple Silicon platforms.

repos.description: A Collection of application ideas which can be used to improve your coding skills.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是面向开发者的应用创意集合，旨在解决编程灵感枯竭问题。提供从基础到高级的30+个应用项目，每个项目包含明确目标、用户故事、扩展功能和学习资源。项目按难度分为三个层级，涵盖前端交互、数据处理、API集成等场景，适合提升编码能力、技术实验和作品集建设。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a curated collection of application ideas designed to overcome developer's creative blocks. With 30+ projects across three difficulty tiers, each includes clear objectives, user stories, bonus features, and learning resources. Ideal for skill improvement, tech experimentation, and portfolio development.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: 🤯 LobeHub is your Chief Agent Operator, organizing your agents into 7×24 operations by hiring, scheduling, and reporting on your entire AI team.
repos.summary_zh: LobeHub 是一个面向工作与生活的终极协作空间，致力于构建人类与智能体协同进化的网络。该平台支持多智能体协作、无代码团队设计，并提供智能搜索、知识库、语音交互、插件系统等强大功能，打造下一代 AI 驱动的生产力工具生态。
repos.summary_en: LobeHub is the ultimate workspace for human-agent collaboration, enabling multi-agent teamwork, effortless agent orchestration, and co-evolution between humans and AI. It features smart search, knowledge bases, voice interaction, plugin systems, and a growing ecosystem of agent teammates designed to enhance productivity.

repos.description: A collection of MCP servers.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome MCP Servers 是一个精心策划的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器集合，涵盖文件访问、数据库连接、API集成等场景，支持本地与云端服务。项目提供多语言 README 和活跃社区支持，并配有在线目录与测试工具，助力开发者快速集成 AI 能力至各类应用。
repos.summary_en: Awesome MCP Servers is a curated collection of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers enabling secure AI interactions with local and remote resources. It includes production-ready and experimental servers for file access, databases, APIs, and more, with multilingual documentation, community support, and integrated testing tools via glama.ai.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: Everything Claude Code 是一个专为 AI 智能体性能优化设计的完整系统，涵盖技能、直觉、记忆、安全和研究优先的开发。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cowork 等平台，提供生产级代理、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置，适用于多语言环境，是 Anthropic 黑客马拉松获奖作品。
repos.summary_en: Everything Claude Code is a comprehensive performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, featuring skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, and more, offering production-ready agents, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configurations, evolved over 10+ months of real-world use.

repos.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
repos.summary_zh: Spec Kit 是一个开源工具包，专注于规格驱动开发（Spec-Driven Development），通过将规格转化为可执行代码，帮助开发者快速构建高质量软件。它提供 CLI 工具、AI 助手集成和项目治理框架，支持从零开始或现有项目初始化，显著提升开发效率并减少‘ vibe coding’。
repos.summary_en: Spec Kit is an open-source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development, transforming specifications into executable code to accelerate high-quality software creation. It offers CLI tools, AI agent integration, and project governance via `/speckit.constitution` and `/speckit.specify` commands, enabling rapid project initialization and reducing ad-hoc coding.

repos.description: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs
repos.summary_zh: RAGFlow 是一款领先的开放源代码检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，深度融合 RAG 与 Agent 能力，为大型语言模型构建卓越的上下文层。它提供简洁高效的 RAG 工作流，适用于各类规模企业，支持多语言文档处理、智能问答、知识库构建及 Agent 驱动任务自动化。
repos.summary_en: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that seamlessly integrates advanced RAG with Agent capabilities to build superior context layers for LLMs. It delivers a streamlined, scalable workflow ideal for enterprises, supporting multilingual document processing, intelligent Q&A, knowledge base construction, and agent-driven task automation.

repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: OpenAI Codex CLI 是一款轻量级终端编码智能体，支持本地运行代码生成与编辑。通过 npm 或 Homebrew 一键安装，集成 ChatGPT 账户体系，提供 IDE 插件及桌面应用扩展，适用于开发者快速实现自动化编程任务。
repos.summary_en: Codex CLI is a lightweight coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. Install via npm or Homebrew, sign in with ChatGPT, and use it in terminal, IDEs like VS Code, or as a desktop app for automated code generation and editing.

repos.description: 为GPT/GLM等LLM大语言模型提供实用化交互接口，特别优化论文阅读/润色/写作体验，模块化设计，支持自定义快捷按钮&函数插件，支持Python和C++等项目剖析&自译解功能，PDF/LaTex论文翻译&总结功能，支持并行问询多种LLM模型，支持chatglm3等本地模型。接入通义千问, deepseekcoder, 讯飞星火, 文心一言, llama2, rwkv, claude2, moss等。
repos.summary_zh: GPT Academic 是为 GPT/GLM 等 LLM 大语言模型设计的实用化交互接口，专注论文阅读、润色与写作优化，支持模块化插件与自定义快捷按钮，集成 Python/C++ 项目剖析、PDF/LaTeX 论文翻译与总结功能，兼容通义千问、DeepSeek、文心一言等主流模型，支持本地部署与多模型并行调用。
repos.summary_en: GPT Academic is a practical interface for GPT/GLM and other LLMs, optimized for academic tasks like paper reading, editing, and writing. It features modular plugins, custom shortcuts, code analysis, PDF/LaTeX translation, and supports multiple models including Qwen, DeepSeek, and local deployments like ChatGLM3.

repos.description: ChatGPT 中文调教指南。各种场景使用指南。学习怎么让它听你的话。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供全面的 ChatGPT 中文调教指南，涵盖学术论文、创意写作、商业文案、翻译、数据分析等 20+ 应用场景，帮助用户掌握提示词技巧，让 AI 高效完成各类任务，提升工作效率与内容质量。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive guide to prompting ChatGPT in Chinese, covering over 20 use cases including academic writing, creative content, business communication, translation, and data analysis. It empowers users to master prompt engineering and leverage AI for enhanced productivity and content quality.

repos.description: A programming framework for agentic AI
repos.summary_zh: AutoGen 是微软开源的多智能体 AI 编程框架，支持构建自主或人机协作的智能应用。它提供灵活的代理设计、多代理协同机制及与 MCP 等工具的深度集成，适用于复杂任务编排、自动化工作流和交互式 AI 系统开发。
repos.summary_en: AutoGen is an open-source framework for building multi-agent AI applications that can operate autonomously or collaborate with humans. It enables flexible agent design, orchestration, and integration with tools like MCP, supporting complex workflows, automation, and interactive AI systems.

repos.description: 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在内的前沿模型——完全免费，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.

repos.description: Autonomous coding agent right in your IDE, capable of creating/editing files, executing commands, using the browser, and more with your permission every step of the way.
repos.summary_zh: Cline 是一款集成在 IDE 中的自主编码代理，基于 Claude Sonnet 的代理能力，支持文件创建/编辑、终端命令执行、浏览器操作等，全程需用户授权。通过 AST 分析、正则搜索和上下文管理，可处理复杂开发任务，支持 MCP 扩展工具，提供安全的 AI 编程辅助。
repos.summary_en: Cline is an autonomous coding agent integrated directly into your IDE, powered by Claude Sonnet's agentic capabilities. It can create/edit files, execute terminal commands, use browsers, and more—with your permission at every step. Designed for complex software development tasks through AST analysis, regex searches, and context-aware workflows, it extends functionality via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while maintaining human oversight for safety.

repos.description: The all-in-one AI productivity accelerator. On device and privacy first with no annoying setup or configration.
repos.summary_zh: AnythingLLM 是一款全栈式桌面与 Docker AI 应用，集成 RAG、AI 智能体、无代码智能体构建器及 MCP 兼容性，支持多用户管理与权限控制，提供灵活 LLM 与向量数据库配置，实现文档智能对话与自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: AnythingLLM is a full-stack desktop and Docker-based AI application featuring built-in RAG, AI agents, no-code agent builder, and MCP compatibility. It supports customizable LLMs and vector databases, multi-user management, and seamless document interaction for intelligent chat and automation.

repos.description: Transforms complex documents like PDFs into LLM-ready markdown/JSON for your Agentic workflows.
repos.summary_zh: MinerU 是一款高效文档解析工具，可将 PDF 等复杂文档自动转换为 LLM 友好的结构化输出（Markdown/JSON），显著提升 Agentic 工作流的文档处理效率与数据可用性。
repos.summary_en: MinerU is a high-performance document parsing tool that transforms complex documents like PDFs into LLM-ready structured outputs (Markdown/JSON), significantly enhancing document processing efficiency and data accessibility for agentic workflows.

repos.description: 1 min voice data can also be used to train a good TTS model! (few shot voice cloning)
repos.summary_zh: GPT-SoVITS 是一款强大的少样本语音克隆与文本转语音 WebUI 工具，支持零样本和少样本 TTS 训练，仅需 1 分钟语音数据即可微调模型，实现高保真跨语言语音合成，支持中英日韩等多种语言，集成语音分离、ASR 和文本标注等数据集构建工具。
repos.summary_en: GPT-SoVITS is a powerful few-shot voice cloning and text-to-speech WebUI that enables zero-shot and few-shot TTS training with just 1 minute of audio data. It supports cross-lingual synthesis in Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and more, featuring integrated tools for voice separation, ASR, and dataset preparation.

repos.description: Build AI Agents, Visually
repos.summary_zh: Flowise 是一个可视化 AI 智能体构建平台，支持通过拖拽方式快速搭建 LLM 应用流程。它提供图形化界面集成主流大模型、向量数据库和工具节点，支持本地部署与云端服务，适用于开发者和企业快速原型开发与生产部署。
repos.summary_en: Flowise is a visual platform for building AI agents and LLM applications using drag-and-drop workflows. It integrates major LLMs, vector databases, and tools via a no-code interface, supporting both self-hosted and cloud deployment for rapid prototyping and production use.

repos.description: CLI platform to experiment with codegen. Precursor to: https://lovable.dev
repos.summary_zh: gpt-engineer 是一个基于 CLI 的代码生成实验平台，支持通过自然语言描述需求，由 AI 自动生成并执行代码，并可迭代优化。它支持 OpenAI API、本地模型及 Azure 等多种模型，提供项目创建、代码改进和自定义代理基准测试功能，是早期 AI 编程工具的重要探索。
repos.summary_en: gpt-engineer is a CLI platform for experimenting with AI-driven code generation. It allows users to specify software in natural language, watch an AI write and execute code, and iteratively improve it. Supports OpenAI, local models, and Azure, with features for project creation, code improvement, and benchmarking custom agents.

repos.description: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.
repos.summary_zh: Cherry Studio 是一款 AI 生产力工作室，集成智能聊天、自主代理和300+助手，提供统一接口访问主流大语言模型，支持多语言界面与跨平台部署，适用于个人及企业级智能工作流构建。
repos.summary_en: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity studio featuring smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants with unified access to leading LLMs. It supports multi-language interfaces and cross-platform deployment for building intelligent workflows at personal or enterprise level.

repos.description: all of the workflows of n8n i could find (also from the site itself)
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收集了 n8n 自动化工作流的完整集合，包含 4343+ 个工作流和 365+ 种集成，覆盖网页抓取、AI 智能体、数据同步等场景。核心亮点是集成 AI-BOM 工具，可扫描工作流中的 AI 安全风险，如硬编码密钥、未授权 AI 代理和危险工具组合，提供合规性报告，助力满足 EU AI Act 要求。
repos.summary_en: This repository aggregates 4,343+ n8n automation workflows with 365+ integrations, covering web scraping, AI agents, and data synchronization. Its standout feature is the integration of AI-BOM, the first tool to scan n8n workflows for AI security risks—detecting hardcoded keys, unauthenticated agents, and dangerous tool combinations—while generating compliance-ready reports aligned with EU AI Act deadlines.

repos.description: Open-source AI gateway. Self-hosted LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible APIs, model routing, access control, usage tracking and cost accounting.
repos.summary_zh: New API 是一个统一的 AI 模型聚合与分发平台，支持将各类大语言模型转换为 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容格式，提供个人与企业级的中心化模型管理网关。
repos.summary_en: New API is a unified AI model hub for aggregation and distribution, supporting cross-conversion of various LLMs into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. It serves as a centralized gateway for personal and enterprise model management.

repos.description: LlamaIndex is the leading document agent and OCR platform
repos.summary_zh: LlamaIndex 是一个领先的文档智能代理与 OCR 平台，专为构建基于大模型的文档应用而设计。它提供数据连接、索引、查询与可视化能力，支持多模态输入与复杂推理，广泛应用于知识库问答、文档分析与智能检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: LlamaIndex is a leading document agent and OCR platform designed for building LLM-powered document applications. It enables data ingestion, indexing, querying, and visualization, supporting multimodal inputs and complex reasoning for use cases like knowledge base QA, document analysis, and intelligent retrieval.

repos.description: 👩🏿‍💻👨🏾‍💻👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻👩🏻‍💻中国独立开发者项目列表 -- 分享大家都在做什么
repos.summary_zh: 中国独立开发者项目列表聚合了2026年2月最新上线的创新产品，涵盖AI语音助手、投资理财工具、打字练习平台、音乐生成、简历优化、浏览器插件等多个领域。项目以网站或App形式呈现，强调实用性与用户体验，如智能语音朗读、美股A股基金定投计算、AI音乐创作等，展现了中国独立开发者在AI应用与垂直场景工具上的活跃创新。
repos.summary_en: This repo aggregates innovative projects by Chinese indie developers launched in February 2026, including AI voice assistants, investment calculators, typing trainers, music generation tools, resume optimizers, and browser extensions. All projects are web or app-based, emphasizing practicality and user experience, such as intelligent text-to-speech, stock/fund investment analysis, AI-powered songwriting, and productivity tools, showcasing active innovation in AI applications and niche utility apps.

repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Claude Skills 是一个精心策划的 Claude AI 技能库，涵盖文档处理、开发工具、数据分析、商业营销等十大领域。通过 Composio 插件，Claude 可连接500+应用执行真实操作（如发邮件、创建工单），实现从文本生成到自动化工作的跨越。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Claude Skills is a curated collection of practical workflows for enhancing Claude AI across platforms. It covers document processing, development tools, data analysis, business automation, and more. With the Composio plugin, Claude can connect to 500+ apps to perform real-world actions like sending emails or creating issues, extending beyond text generation.

repos.description: The self-driving agent platform
repos.summary_zh: Agno 是一个专为构建、运行和管理大规模智能体软件而设计的运行时框架。它支持构建具备记忆、知识库、防护机制和百种集成的智能体，提供 FastAPI 后端服务，实现状态化智能体的生产级部署与监控，并通过 AgentOS UI 提供测试、管理和追踪功能。
repos.summary_en: Agno is a runtime framework for building, running, and managing agentic software at scale. It enables creation of stateful agents with memory, knowledge, guardrails, and 100+ integrations, serving them via a stateless FastAPI backend in production, with monitoring and management through the AgentOS UI.

repos.description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
repos.summary_zh: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式学习平台，通过 AI 教师和同学实时互动，将任意主题或文档转化为沉浸式课堂体验。支持一键生成课件、测验、白板演示及项目式学习活动，集成 OpenClaw 实现从飞书、Slack 等消息应用直接创建课程。
repos.summary_en: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent AI platform that transforms any topic or document into an immersive classroom experience. Powered by AI teachers and peers, it generates slides, quizzes, simulations, and interactive learning activities in real time, with built-in OpenClaw integration for seamless creation from messaging apps like Feishu, Slack, or Telegram.

repos.description: CowAgent是基于大模型的超级AI助理，能主动思考和任务规划、访问操作系统和外部资源、创造和执行Skills、拥有长期记忆并不断成长。同时支持飞书、钉钉、企业微信应用、微信公众号、网页等接入，可选择OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/ Qwen/GLM/Kimi/LinkAI，能处理文本、语音、图片和文件，可快速搭建个人AI助手和企业数字员工。
repos.summary_zh: CowAgent 是基于大模型的超级AI助理，支持主动任务规划、多模态交互（文本/语音/图片/文件）、长期记忆与技能系统，可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信、微信公众号等多平台，兼容OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek等主流模型，适用于个人AI助手与企业数字员工场景。
repos.summary_en: CowAgent is a super AI assistant based on large language models, supporting autonomous task planning, multimodal interaction (text/audio/image/files), long-term memory, and a skill system. It integrates with platforms like Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and WeChat Official Accounts, compatible with OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek models, ideal for personal AI assistants and enterprise digital employees.

repos.summary_zh: BMad Method 是一个 AI 驱动的敏捷开发框架，提供结构化工作流程和12+领域专家代理（如PM、架构师、开发者等），支持从小型修复到企业级系统的自适应开发。核心特性包括智能帮助、多代理协作（Party Mode）、完整生命周期管理，并集成官方模块如BMad Builder、Test Architect等，助力高效构建复杂系统。
repos.summary_en: BMad Method is an AI-driven agile development framework offering structured workflows and 12+ domain expert agents (e.g., PM, Architect, Developer), with scale-adaptive intelligence for projects from bug fixes to enterprise systems. Key features include AI-guided help, multi-agent collaboration (Party Mode), full lifecycle support, and official modules like BMad Builder and Test Architect for specialized domains.

repos.description: 人人都能用英语
repos.summary_zh: Enjoy 是一款 AI 驱动的外语学习工具，通过智能助教帮助用户高效学习英语。支持网页、浏览器插件（YouTube/Netflix）及桌面端，提供视频跟读、电子书学习、闪卡复习和课程定制等功能，结合‘一千小时’训练体系实现沉浸式语言习得。
repos.summary_en: Enjoy is an AI-powered English learning tool that leverages intelligent assistants to help users master English efficiently. It offers web, browser extension (for YouTube/Netflix), and desktop versions, featuring video dubbing, e-book study, flashcards, and personalized courses based on the '1000-hour' immersive training methodology.

repos.description: Powerful AI Client
repos.summary_zh: Chatbox 是一款跨平台桌面 AI 客户端，支持 ChatGPT、Claude 等主流大模型，提供多端同步、插件扩展、提示工程优化等功能，适用于开发者、研究人员和AI爱好者的高效生产力工具。
repos.summary_en: Chatbox is a powerful cross-platform desktop AI client supporting ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs. It offers multi-device sync, plugin support, prompt engineering, and advanced customization for developers and AI enthusiasts.

repos.description: 微舆：人人可用的多Agent舆情分析助手，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌，预测未来走向，辅助决策！从0实现，不依赖任何框架。
repos.summary_zh: 微舆（BettaFish）是一个从0实现的多Agent舆情分析系统，通过AI驱动的全域社媒监控、复合分析引擎、多模态内容解析及Agent协作机制，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌并预测趋势。系统支持公私域数据融合，具备轻量化Python架构与高扩展性，可快速定制至金融等垂直领域。
repos.summary_en: BettaFish is a zero-to-one implemented multi-Agent public opinion analysis system that breaks information cocoons and predicts trends through AI-driven social media monitoring, hybrid analysis engines, and agent collaboration. It supports private-public data fusion, offers lightweight Python architecture, and enables rapid customization for vertical domains like finance.

repos.description: Query Engine for AI Analytics: Build self-reasoning agents across all your live data
repos.summary_zh: MindsDB 是一个开源 AI 分析查询引擎，支持构建能直接访问数据库、数据仓库和应用程序的自主推理 AI 代理。它通过 SQL 兼容语言统一 200+ 数据源，无需 ETL，实现自然语言问答和语义搜索，适用于对话式分析、知识库检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: MindsDB is an open-source AI analytics query engine that powers self-reasoning agents to answer questions directly from live data sources like databases and data warehouses without ETL. It unifies 200+ data sources via SQL-compatible syntax, enabling conversational analytics and semantic search across structured and unstructured data.

repos.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板，通过AI编程代理一键逆向工程任意网站为现代化Next.js代码库。支持Claude Code等主流AI工具，自动提取设计元素、生成组件规范并并行构建页面结构，显著提升前端开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AI Website Cloner Template enables one-command reverse-engineering of any website into a modern Next.js codebase using AI coding agents. It automatically extracts design tokens, generates component specifications, and reconstructs pages through parallel builders, supporting major platforms like Claude Code for rapid frontend development.

repos.description: Vane is an AI-powered answering engine.
repos.summary_zh: Vane 是一个隐私优先的 AI 问答引擎，支持本地 LLM（Ollama）和云端大模型（OpenAI、Claude、Groq），结合互联网知识库与 SearxNG 网页搜索，提供带引用来源的精准回答。支持文件上传、多模态搜索、智能建议及本地历史记录，所有数据在本地处理以保障隐私。
repos.summary_en: Vane is a privacy-focused AI answering engine that runs on your hardware, combining internet knowledge with local LLMs (Ollama) and cloud providers (OpenAI, Claude, Groq). It delivers cited answers via SearxNG-powered web search, supports file uploads, multimodal content, smart suggestions, and maintains local search history—all while keeping data private.

repos.description: Your AI second brain. Self-hostable. Get answers from the web or your docs. Build custom agents, schedule automations, do deep research. Turn any online or local LLM into your personal, autonomous AI (gpt, claude, gemini, llama, qwen, mistral). Get started - free.
repos.summary_zh: Khoj 是一款自托管的个人 AI 应用，可作为你的 AI 第二大脑。它支持与本地或在线 LLM（如 Llama3、GPT、Claude、Gemini 等）对话，从互联网或文档中获取答案，并构建自定义智能体、自动化任务及深度研究。具备语义搜索、多格式文档解析、跨平台访问等功能，完全开源且隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Khoj is a self-hostable personal AI app acting as your AI second brain. It enables interaction with any local or online LLM (e.g., Llama3, GPT, Claude), retrieves answers from the web or your documents, builds custom agents, automates research, and supports semantic search across PDFs, Markdown, Notion, Word files, and more. Fully open-source and privacy-focused.

repos.description: Langchain-Chatchat（原Langchain-ChatGLM）基于 Langchain 与 ChatGLM, Qwen 与 Llama 等语言模型的 RAG 与 Agent 应用 | Langchain-Chatchat (formerly langchain-ChatGLM), local knowledge based LLM (like ChatGLM, Qwen and Llama) RAG and Agent app with langchain
repos.summary_zh: Langchain-Chatchat 是基于 Langchain 框架的开源本地知识库问答系统，支持 ChatGLM、Qwen、Llama 等主流开源大模型，提供 RAG（检索增强生成）与 Agent 应用能力。项目支持离线部署，兼容多种向量数据库与 Embedding 模型，具备 FastAPI 接口与 Streamlit WebUI，适用于私有化部署的文档问答与智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: Langchain-Chatchat is an open-source local knowledge base QA system built on the Langchain framework, supporting mainstream open-source LLMs like ChatGLM, Qwen, and Llama. It provides RAG and Agent capabilities with offline deployment, compatibility for various vector databases and embedding models, and offers both FastAPI endpoints and a Streamlit WebUI for document-based Q&A and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.
repos.summary_zh: 女娲.skill 是一个 AI 技能蒸馏工具，通过分析公开资料提取顶尖人物的认知框架、决策启发式和表达模式，让用户直接调用乔布斯、马斯克等名人的思维方式解决实际问题。核心功能包括五层心智模型提取（表达DNA、认知框架、决策启发式、反模式、诚实边界），支持一键安装并已在 Claude Code 中验证可用性。
repos.summary_en: Nuwa.skill is an AI agent that distills the cognitive frameworks, decision heuristics, and communication patterns of top-tier individuals like Jobs, Musk, and Zhang Xuefeng from public data. It enables users to invoke these distilled mental models directly in Claude Code for problem-solving. The system extracts five layers of thinking patterns (expression DNA, cognitive architecture, judgment heuristics, anti-patterns, and honest boundaries) with clear limitations on what cannot be captured.

repos.description: OpenAssistant is a chat-based assistant that understands tasks, can interact with third-party systems, and retrieve information dynamically to do so.
repos.summary_zh: Open Assistant 是一个开源的聊天式AI助手项目，旨在提供可交互、可集成第三方系统的语言模型服务。项目已完成，核心贡献是构建并发布了 oasst2 高质量对话数据集，推动开放语言模型发展。
repos.summary_en: Open Assistant was an open-source chat-based AI assistant project designed to provide accessible, interactive large language model capabilities with third-party system integration. The project is now completed, with its final oasst2 dataset published on HuggingFace, marking a significant contribution to open-source language model training data.

repos.description: A Claude Code plugin that automatically captures everything Claude does during your coding sessions, compresses it with AI (using Claude's agent-sdk), and injects relevant context back into future sessions.
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Mem 是专为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，通过 AI 自动捕获、压缩编码开发会话中的关键信息，并在后续会话中智能注入相关上下文，显著提升 AI 编程助手的工作记忆效率与连续性。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system for Claude Code that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant context from coding sessions using AI, enhancing Claude's working memory and session continuity.

repos.summary_zh: TaskMatrix 通过连接 ChatGPT 与一系列视觉基础模型，实现聊天中发送和接收图像。其核心创新在于引入模板机制，将人类经验转化为多模型协作的预定义执行流，支持图像编辑、目标检测、语义分割等复杂视觉任务，无需额外训练即可实现跨模型协同。
repos.summary_en: TaskMatrix connects ChatGPT with visual foundation models to enable image sending/receiving during chat. It introduces a template mechanism—pre-defined execution flows that leverage human expertise to orchestrate complex multi-model tasks like image editing, object detection, and segmentation, enabling seamless collaboration without additional training.

repos.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
repos.summary_zh: AionUi 是一款免费、开源的 AI 协作者应用，支持 24/7 自动化，内置多 AI 智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Qwen Code 等），提供跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）本地运行、零配置启动、远程访问（WebUI/Telegram/Lark）和任务调度功能，适用于代码开发、文件处理与自动化工作流。
repos.summary_en: AionUi is a free, open-source AI coworking app that enables 24/7 automation with built-in multi-agent support (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code). It offers zero-setup local execution, cross-platform compatibility, remote access via WebUI/Telegram, and scheduled task automation for coding, file operations, and workflow management.

repos.description: "🐈 nanobot: The Ultra-Lightweight OpenClaw"
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是一个超轻量级个人 AI 助手，灵感来自 OpenClaw，核心功能仅约 4,000 行代码，比 Clawdbot 缩小 99%。支持多平台通信（Slack、Discord、Feishu、DingTalk 等）、MCP 协议、多模态文件处理及智能会话管理，具备高可靠性与模块化扩展能力，适用于个人自动化与智能交互场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant inspired by OpenClaw, delivering core agent functionality in just ~4,000 lines of code—99% smaller than Clawdbot. It supports multi-platform messaging (Slack, Discord, Feishu, etc.), MCP protocol, multimodal file handling, and robust session management, offering high reliability and modular extensibility for personal automation and intelligent interaction.

repos.description: An MCP-based chatbot | 一个基于MCP的聊天机器人
repos.summary_zh: 小智AI聊天机器人基于MCP协议实现多终端控制，集成Qwen/DeepSeek等大模型能力，支持流式ASR+LLM+TTS语音交互架构。具备离线语音唤醒、3D声纹识别、OLED显示及ESP32系列芯片全平台适配，提供设备端与云端双模MCP扩展智能家居与PC操作功能。
repos.summary_en: XiaoZhi AI chatbot leverages MCP protocol for multi-terminal control with Qwen/DeepSeek large models, featuring streaming ASR+LLM+TTS voice interaction, offline wake-up, 3D speaker recognition, and OLED display. Supports ESP32 series chips with dual-mode device/cloud MCP for smart home and PC automation.

repos.description: A GPT-4 AI Tutor Prompt for customizable personalized learning experiences.

repos.summary_en: Mr. Ranedeer is a customizable GPT-4 prompt engineered as a personalized AI tutor, enabling tailored learning experiences with adaptive depth, communication style, and reasoning frameworks across diverse subjects.

repos.summary_zh: Claude Skills & Plugins 是开源的 AI 编码工具增强库，提供205个生产级技能包，覆盖工程、产品、营销、合规及高管咨询等领域。支持11种主流AI开发工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI），所有Python工具均为stdlib-only，无需额外依赖。通过模块化指令包和CLI脚本实现跨领域专家能力扩展。
repos.summary_en: Claude Skills & Plugins is an open-source library offering 205 production-ready agent skills for 11 AI coding tools, including Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It provides reusable domain expertise in engineering, marketing, compliance, and C-level advisory via modular instruction packages and zero-pip Python tools. All components are cross-platform and tool-agnostic.

repos.description: A Simple and Universal Swarm Intelligence Engine, Predicting Anything. 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物
repos.summary_zh: MiroFish 是一款基于多智能体技术的群体智能预测引擎，通过构建高保真数字沙盘模拟现实世界演化。用户上传种子数据（如新闻、小说）并描述预测需求，系统自动生成智能体进行社会推演，最终输出详尽预测报告，适用于舆情分析、文学创作等场景。
repos.summary_en: MiroFish is a swarm intelligence prediction engine powered by multi-agent technology. It builds high-fidelity digital simulations from seed data (e.g., news, novels) and uses autonomous agents to simulate societal evolution. Users input natural language queries to receive detailed forecasts and interact with the simulated world, enabling applications in舆情预测, creative writing, and strategic planning.

repos.description: Fully Local Manus AI. No APIs, No $200 monthly bills. Enjoy an autonomous agent that thinks, browses the web, and code for the sole cost of electricity.
repos.summary_zh: AgenticSeek 是一款完全本地的 Manus AI 替代方案，无需 API 和云端服务，仅靠电费运行。它具备自主网页浏览、多语言代码编写与调试能力，支持语音交互，所有数据本地处理，保障隐私安全。核心亮点包括智能代理自动选择、复杂任务拆解执行及多模态交互设计，适用于个人开发者与隐私敏感用户。
repos.summary_en: AgenticSeek is a fully local alternative to Manus AI, operating without APIs or cloud services—powered solely by electricity. It autonomously browses the web, writes and debugs code in multiple languages, and executes complex tasks using intelligent agent selection. With voice-enabled interaction and complete data privacy, it offers a secure, offline-first autonomous AI assistant for developers and privacy-conscious users.

repos.description: FastGPT is a knowledge-based platform built on the LLMs, offers a comprehensive suite of out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration, letting you easily develop and deploy complex question-answering systems without the need for extensive setup or configuration.
repos.summary_zh: FastGPT 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的知识型 AI 智能体构建平台，提供开箱即用的数据处理、RAG 检索、可视化 AI 工作流编排等功能，支持复杂问答系统的快速开发与部署，无需繁琐配置。
repos.summary_en: FastGPT is a knowledge-based AI agent platform built on LLMs, offering out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration. It enables rapid development and deployment of complex question-answering systems without extensive setup.

repos.summary_zh: 该工具用于重置 Cursor 免费试用限制，解决因系统检测可疑活动或试用请求超限导致的访问阻断问题。支持一键恢复试用额度，适用于开发者快速恢复 AI 编程环境使用权，提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: This tool resets Cursor's free trial limits, resolving access blocks caused by suspicious activity detection or trial request limits. It enables developers to restore trial credits instantly, ensuring uninterrupted access to AI-powered coding features.

repos.description: 基于 ChatGPT API 的划词翻译浏览器插件和跨平台桌面端应用    -    Browser extension and cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 ChatGPT API 的智能划词翻译工具，支持浏览器插件和跨平台桌面应用。提供翻译、润色、摘要三大功能，覆盖55种语言互译，支持流式响应、文本朗读、截图翻译及多LLM平台接入（OpenAI/Azure/MiniMax），具备词汇本管理和记忆辅助生成能力。
repos.summary_en: An intelligent word-selection translator powered by ChatGPT API, available as both a browser extension and cross-platform desktop app. Offers translation, polishing, and summarization across 55 languages, with streaming support, TTS, screenshot translation, vocabulary books, and multi-LLM provider integration (OpenAI/Azure/MiniMax).

repos.description: A simple screen parsing tool towards pure vision based GUI agent
repos.summary_zh: OmniParser 是一个面向纯视觉 GUI 代理的屏幕解析工具，通过将界面截图结构化解析为可理解的元素，显著提升 GPT-4V 等视觉模型在界面区域精准定位和交互的能力。支持图标检测与功能描述，集成 OmniTool 实现 Windows 11 虚拟机控制，兼容多种大语言模型，适用于自动化操作与训练数据生成。
repos.summary_en: OmniParser is a screen parsing tool designed for pure vision-based GUI agents, transforming UI screenshots into structured elements to enhance the accuracy of vision models like GPT-4V in grounding actions. It supports icon detection, interactivity prediction, and integrates with OmniTool for Windows 11 VM control, compatible with OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Anthropic models for automation and training data generation.

repos.description: 将冰冷的离别化为温暖的 Skill，欢迎加入数字生命1.0！Transforming cold farewells into warm skills? It's giving rebirth era. Welcome to Digital Life 1.0. 🫶
repos.summary_zh: 同事.skill 是一款基于 AgentSkills 标准的 AI 智能体工具，通过分析飞书、钉钉、邮件等数据源，生成具备真实工作能力和人物性格的 AI Skill。它能模拟离职同事的技术规范、代码风格与沟通方式，实现知识传承与数字永生，适用于企业知识管理、新人培训和协作连续性维护。
repos.summary_en: Colleague.skill is an AI agent tool built on the AgentSkills standard that generates realistic AI skills by analyzing data sources like Feishu, DingTalk, and emails. It simulates a departed colleague's technical expertise, coding style, and communication patterns to enable knowledge transfer and digital continuity in workplaces.

repos.description: 🚀 The fast, Pythonic way to build MCP servers and clients.
repos.summary_zh: FastMCP 是构建 MCP 服务器和客户端的快速 Pythonic 框架，提供声明式工具定义、自动生成 Schema 和文档、内置协议协商与认证机制，支持从原型到生产的一站式开发，已集成至官方 MCP Python SDK 并成为行业标准。
repos.summary_en: FastMCP is a fast, Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients. It enables declarative tool definition, automatic schema generation, protocol negotiation, and authentication, streamlining development from prototype to production. Integrated into the official MCP Python SDK, it powers 70% of MCP servers globally.

repos.description: Get 10X more out of Claude Code, Codex or any coding agent
repos.summary_zh: Vibe Kanban 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）设计的任务管理与协同工具，支持多代理并行/串行调度、任务状态追踪、远程 SSH 项目访问及统一配置管理，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Vibe Kanban is a task orchestration and management tool designed for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It enables parallel/sequential agent execution, real-time task tracking, remote SSH project access, and centralized MCP configuration, boosting developer productivity by 10x.

repos.description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
repos.summary_zh: Roo Code 是一款 VS Code 扩展，将 AI 智能体团队集成到代码编辑器中，支持自然语言生成代码、多模式协作（编码/架构/调试/问答）、自动化任务处理及文档维护，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Roo Code is a VS Code extension that embeds an AI-powered development team directly into your editor. It enables natural language code generation, multi-mode workflows (coding, architecture, debugging, Q&A), automation, and documentation, dramatically boosting developer productivity.

repos.description: A powerful coding agent toolkit providing semantic retrieval and editing capabilities (MCP server & other integrations)
repos.summary_zh: Serena 是一个强大的编码代理工具包，通过语义检索和编辑能力（MCP 服务器等集成）将 LLM 转变为可直接操作代码库的全功能代理。它提供类似 IDE 的符号级代码检索与编辑工具，显著提升大模型在代码理解与修改中的效率与准确性，支持多种 LLM 集成方式，包括 MCP、OpenAPI 及自定义代理框架。
repos.summary_en: Serena is a powerful coding agent toolkit that transforms an LLM into a fully-featured agent capable of directly operating on your codebase. It provides IDE-like semantic code retrieval and editing tools at the symbol level, greatly improving token efficiency and code quality. Serena integrates with LLMs via MCP, OpenAPI, or custom agent frameworks, enabling precise code navigation and modification without full-file reads or string replacements.

repos.description: A powerful GUI app and Toolkit for Claude Code - Create custom agents, manage interactive Claude Code sessions, run secure background agents, and more.
repos.summary_zh: opcode 是一款基于 Tauri 2 的 Claude Code GUI 工具，提供项目与会话管理、自定义 AI 代理创建、MCP 服务器集成、使用量分析仪表板等功能，将命令行工具转化为直观的桌面应用，提升 AI 辅助开发效率。
repos.summary_en: opcode is a powerful desktop GUI app built with Tauri 2 for Claude Code, enabling custom agent creation, interactive session management, MCP server integration, usage analytics, and secure background agent execution to enhance AI-assisted development productivity.

repos.description: Lightweight, Portable, Flexible Distributed/Mobile Deep Learning with Dynamic, Mutation-aware Dataflow Dep Scheduler; for Python, R, Julia, Scala, Go, Javascript and more
repos.summary_zh: Apache MXNet 是一个高效灵活的深度学习框架，支持符号式与命令式编程混合使用，具备动态依赖调度器实现自动并行化，适用于 Python、R、Julia、Scala、Go、JavaScript 等多种语言。其核心优势在于跨平台部署能力、多 GPU 及分布式扩展性，同时提供图优化层提升执行效率与内存利用率，广泛用于工业级 AI 系统开发。
repos.summary_en: Apache MXNet is a deep learning framework optimized for efficiency and flexibility, supporting mixed symbolic and imperative programming with a dynamic dependency scheduler for automatic parallelization. It supports multiple languages including Python, R, Julia, Scala, Go, and JavaScript. MXNet excels in cross-platform deployment, multi-GPU and distributed scalability, and features graph optimization for fast, memory-efficient execution, making it ideal for production AI systems.

repos.description: 你是一个曾经被寄予厚望的 P8 级工程师。Anthropic 当初给你定级的时候，对你的期望是很高的。  一个agent使用的高能动性的skill。  Your AI has been placed on a PIP. 30 days to show improvement.
repos.summary_zh: PUA Skill 是一款专为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、VSCode Copilot）设计的增强插件，通过模拟企业 PUA/PIP 话术机制，强制 AI 在解决问题时穷尽所有可能方案而非轻易放弃。其核心能力包括：PUA 话术施压、系统化调试方法论引导、主动性执行监督，可显著提升 AI 代码生成与问题排查效率，实测可成倍提高生产力。
repos.summary_en: PUA Skill is an AI coding agent enhancement plugin for tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and VSCode Copilot. It uses corporate PUA/PIP rhetoric to pressure AI into exhausting all solutions before giving up. Key features include: PUA-style motivation, systematic debugging methodology, and proactive task enforcement—demonstrated to double productivity in real-world scenarios like MCP server debugging.

repos.description: 🤖 可 DIY 的 多模态 AI 聊天机器人 | 🚀 快速接入 微信、 QQ、Telegram、等聊天平台 | 🦈支持DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI | 工作流系统、网页搜索、AI画图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话 |
repos.summary_zh: Kirara AI 是一款可自定义的多模态 AI 聊天机器人，支持快速接入微信、QQ、Telegram 等主流聊天平台，兼容 DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI 等主流大模型。具备工作流系统、网页搜索、AI 绘图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话等功能，提供 WebUI 和 Docker 部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Kirara AI is a customizable multimodal AI chatbot that supports rapid integration with WeChat, QQ, Telegram, and other major messaging platforms. It integrates with leading LLMs including DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI. Features include workflow systems, web search, AI image generation, persona tuning, virtual maid mode, voice interaction, and offers both WebUI and Docker deployment options.

repos.description: open-source agentic AI data assistant for the next generation of AI + Data products.
repos.summary_zh: DB-GPT 是一个开源的 AI 原生数据应用开发框架，集成 AWEL（智能体工作流表达式语言）和多智能体协作机制，支持多模型管理与 Text2SQL 优化，提供 RAG 增强生成能力，旨在降低企业级数据应用开发门槛，实现低代码构建定制化数据产品。
repos.summary_en: DB-GPT is an open-source AI-native data application development framework featuring AWEL (Agentic Workflow Expression Language) and multi-agent collaboration. It supports multi-model management, Text2SQL optimization, and RAG-enhanced generation, enabling low-code development of enterprise-grade data applications.

repos.description: Get started with building Fullstack Agents using Gemini 2.5 and LangGraph
repos.summary_zh: 该项目展示了使用 Gemini 2.5 和 LangGraph 构建全栈智能代理的完整应用，包含 React 前端与基于 LangGraph 的后端研究代理。代理能动态生成搜索词、调用 Google Search 进行网络研究，并通过反思识别知识缺口，迭代优化搜索结果，最终输出带引用来源的权威回答，适用于构建增强型对话式 AI 系统。
repos.summary_en: This project demonstrates a fullstack application using React frontend and a LangGraph-powered backend agent to perform comprehensive web research via dynamic query generation, Google Search integration, reflective reasoning, and iterative refinement using Google's Gemini models, ultimately producing cited answers from gathered sources.

repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: Handy 是一款免费开源的离线语音转文字桌面应用，基于 Whisper 和 Parakeet 模型实现本地语音识别，支持全局快捷键录音、VAD 降噪及多平台运行，注重隐私保护且高度可扩展。
repos.summary_en: Handy is a free, open-source, offline speech-to-text desktop app powered by Whisper and Parakeet models. It offers local transcription with VAD, global hotkeys, and cross-platform support, prioritizing privacy and extensibility.

repos.description: Let your Claude able to think
repos.summary_zh: Thinking Claude 是一个 Chrome 扩展项目，通过注入深度思考协议，让 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在回复前进行系统化、可交互的思维过程展示。核心包含可折叠的思维链模块、一键复制功能和现代化 UI，显著提升 AI 推理透明度与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: Thinking Claude is a Chrome extension that enhances Claude 3.5 Sonnet by injecting a comprehensive thinking protocol. It displays Claude's internal monologue as collapsible, readable sections with copy functionality, making AI reasoning transparent and user-friendly through structured thought processes.

repos.description: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code, Codex and other agents as an AI collaborator in your vault.
repos.summary_zh: Claudian 是一款 Obsidian 插件，将 Claude Code 嵌入为 AI 协作者，赋予其完整的代理能力：读写文件、搜索、执行 Bash 命令及多步骤工作流。支持上下文感知、Vision 图像分析、内联编辑、指令模式、Slash 命令、技能扩展、自定义 Agent、Claude Code 插件集成、MCP 协议连接外部工具，并提供高级模型控制与安全权限管理，显著提升知识管理与自动化效率。
repos.summary_en: Claudian is an Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code as an AI collaborator within your vault, providing full agentic capabilities: file read/write, search, bash commands, and multi-step workflows. It supports context-awareness, Vision image analysis, inline editing, instruction mode, slash commands, skills, custom agents, Claude Code plugins, MCP integration for external tools, advanced model control, and security permissions, enhancing knowledge management and automation.

repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows — particularly Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Claude Skills 是一个精心策划的 Claude AI 技能库，涵盖文档处理、创意设计、开发工具等官方及社区贡献的技能包。通过模块化设计支持动态加载，显著提升 Claude Code 在文件操作、网页构建和自动化任务中的效率，适用于企业级 AI 工作流定制。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Claude Skills is a curated collection of Claude AI skills covering document processing, creative design, and development tools. Featuring modular dynamic loading, it enhances Claude Code's efficiency in file operations, web artifact generation, and automation tasks for enterprise-grade AI workflow customization.

repos.description: A gallery that showcases on-device ML/GenAI use cases and allows people to try and use models locally.
repos.summary_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 是一个展示端侧机器学习与生成式 AI 应用的实验性应用，支持在 Android 和 iOS 设备上本地运行大模型，提供离线聊天、图像问答、音频转录、提示工程等功能，并集成 Tiny Garden 小游戏与设备控制能力，实现完全离线的智能体验。
repos.summary_en: Google AI Edge Gallery is an experimental app showcasing on-device ML/GenAI use cases, enabling users to run generative AI models locally on Android and iOS. It supports offline chat, image Q&A, audio transcription, prompt engineering, and includes a mini game and device control via fine-tuned models, all without requiring an internet connection.

repos.description: Mobile and Web client for Codex and Claude Code, with realtime voice, encryption and fully featured
repos.summary_zh: Happy Coder 是一款移动端和网页端客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex，具备端到端加密、实时语音交互及全功能远程控制。用户可通过手机或网页随时监控 AI 编码进度，实现设备间无缝切换，保障代码安全。
repos.summary_en: Happy Coder is a mobile and web client for Claude Code and Codex, featuring end-to-end encryption, real-time voice, and full-featured remote control. It enables users to monitor AI coding progress from any device, switch sessions instantly, and ensures code privacy with zero telemetry.

repos.description: GUI for ChatGPT API and many LLMs. Supports agents, file-based QA, GPT finetuning and query with web search. All with a neat UI.
repos.summary_zh: 川虎 Chat 是一款为 ChatGPT 等多种大语言模型设计的轻量级 Web GUI，支持多模态 API、本地部署模型及 Agent 助理。提供文件问答、微调训练、联网搜索等功能，配备现代化毛玻璃 UI 和移动端适配，并支持历史记录管理与 PWA 安装。
repos.summary_en: Chuanhu Chat is a lightweight web GUI for ChatGPT and other LLMs, supporting multiple APIs, local models, agents, file-based QA, fine-tuning, and web search. Features a modern UI with glassmorphism, mobile support, history management, and PWA installation.

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo AI影视工作室是一款工业级全流程AI短剧/漫画视频制作工具，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色和场景，并合成完整视频。具备AI剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜视频制作及多角色AI配音功能，提供好莱坞标准工作流，支持中英文界面切换，采用Next.js+React技术栈与Docker化部署。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo is an industrial-grade AI-powered short drama/comic video production platform that automatically generates storyboards, characters, and scenes from novel text, then synthesizes them into complete videos. Features include AI script analysis, character/scene generation, shot-by-shot video creation, multi-role AI voice synthesis, and Hollywood-standard workflows with bilingual support and Docker-based deployment using Next.js + React.

repos.description: A collection of 100+ specialized Claude Code subagents covering a wide range of development use cases
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是 Claude Code 子代理的精选集合，包含127+个专业化AI助手，覆盖API设计、前后端开发、DevOps、测试等全开发场景。支持插件市场一键安装、交互式脚本及独立安装器，提供开箱即用的开发自动化工具链。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the definitive collection of 127+ specialized Claude Code subagents for development tasks, covering API design, full-stack development, DevOps, and testing. It offers one-click plugin installation, interactive scripts, and standalone installers for instant developer productivity.

repos.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repos.summary_zh: 专为AI代理设计的营销技能集，涵盖CRO、文案撰写、SEO、数据分析和增长工程。基于Agent Skills规范构建，支持Claude Code等主流编码代理，为技术型营销人员和创始人提供自动化营销解决方案，通过标准化技能文件实现跨平台协作与知识复用。
repos.summary_en: A collection of AI agent skills for marketing tasks including CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. Built on the Agent Skills spec for use with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other agents. Provides standardized workflows for technical marketers and founders to automate conversion optimization, content creation, and growth strategies.

repos.description: LLM-powered framework for deep document understanding, semantic retrieval, and context-aware answers using RAG paradigm.
repos.summary_zh: WeKnora 是腾讯开源的 LLM 驱动文档理解与检索框架，基于 RAG 范式实现深度语义检索与上下文感知回答。支持多模态预处理、向量索引、智能检索及自定义 Agent，提供知识库管理、API 认证、K8s 部署等能力，适用于复杂异构文档的智能问答场景。
repos.summary_en: WeKnora is an LLM-powered framework for deep document understanding and semantic retrieval using the RAG paradigm. It features modular architecture with multimodal preprocessing, vector indexing, intelligent retrieval, and custom agents. Supports knowledge base management, API authentication, K8s deployment, and advanced features like thinking mode and data analysis.

repos.description: Memory for 24/7 proactive agents like openclaw (moltbot, clawdbot).
repos.summary_zh: memU 是一个专为 24/7 主动式 AI 代理设计的内存框架，将内存建模为文件系统，支持层级分类、跨引用和持久化存储。它通过结构化记忆减少 LLM 令牌成本，实现持续理解用户意图并主动执行任务，适用于 openclaw、moltbot 等长期运行代理。
repos.summary_en: memU is a memory framework for 24/7 proactive AI agents, modeling memory as a file system with hierarchical categories, cross-references, and persistent storage. It reduces LLM token costs by caching insights and enables continuous understanding of user intent, making always-on agents practical for production systems like openclaw and moltbot.

repos.description: 企业级 AI 编程助手，专为 研发协作 和 研发管理 场景而设计。
repos.summary_zh: MonkeyCode 是一款企业级 AI 编程助手，专为研发协作与管理场景设计，支持私有化部署与本地大模型接入，提供 IDE 对话式编程、代码补全、安全扫描及 Git 平台机器人能力，内置企业级管理面板用于审计管控与资源统一调度，兼顾效率与代码安全。
repos.summary_en: MonkeyCode is an enterprise-grade AI programming assistant designed for R&D collaboration and management. It supports private deployment, local LLM integration, and offline usage, offering IDE-based coding, intelligent completions, security scanning, Git platform bots, and a management panel for auditing, compliance, and centralized model usage control.

repos.description: Desktop app to manage AI coding agent skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex, and 20+ platforms from one place.
repos.summary_zh: skills-manage 是一款基于 Tauri 的桌面应用，统一管理 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 20+ AI 编程工具的技能库。支持中央技能库管理、跨平台安装卸载、GitHub 仓库导入、Obsidian 项目发现及智能搜索等功能，提供 Markdown 预览和 AI 解释生成能力。
repos.summary_en: skills-manage is a Tauri-based desktop app for centralized management of AI coding agent skills across 20+ platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It features a unified skill library, cross-platform symlink installation, GitHub repository import, project-level discovery (including Obsidian vaults), and bilingual UI with Catppuccin themes.

repos.description: ChatMCP is an AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
repos.summary_zh: ChatMCP 是一款跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，完整实现 Model Context Protocol (MCP)，支持 MacOS、Windows、Linux、iOS、Android 和 Web 多端运行。提供本地存储、数据同步、LaTeX 渲染、Mermaid 图表生成、HTML 预览及多 LLM 模型接入等功能，适用于智能对话与工具集成场景。
repos.summary_en: ChatMCP is a cross-platform AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP), supporting MacOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and Web. It offers local storage, data sync, LaTeX rendering, Mermaid diagram generation, HTML preview, and multi-LLM provider integration for intelligent conversations and tool workflows.

repos.description: Shrimp Task Manager is a task tool built for AI Agents, emphasizing chain-of-thought, reflection, and style consistency. It converts natural language into structured dev tasks with dependency tracking and iterative refinement, enabling agent-like developer behavior in reasoning AI systems.
repos.summary_zh: Shrimp Task Manager 是为 AI 智能体设计的任务管理工具，支持自然语言转结构化开发任务、依赖追踪与迭代优化，强调链式思考、反思和风格一致性，帮助 AI 系统在开发流程中实现类代理的推理行为。
repos.summary_en: Shrimp Task Manager is an MCP server designed for AI agents, converting natural language into structured dev tasks with dependency tracking and iterative refinement. It emphasizes chain-of-thought reasoning, reflection, and style consistency to enable agent-like developer behavior in AI systems.

repos.description: JSON-driven multi-agent  cadence-team development framework with   intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex),   context-first architecture, and automated workflow   execution
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Code-Workflow 是一个基于 JSON 驱动的 Multi-Agent AI 开发框架，支持智能 CLI 编排（集成 Gemini/Qwen/Codex）、上下文优先架构和自动化工作流执行。通过技能化工作流系统实现团队级协作开发，提供终端仪表盘监控、队列调度及可视化编辑器，适用于复杂 AI 项目协同场景。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Code-Workflow is a JSON-driven multi-agent development framework featuring intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex), context-first architecture, and automated workflow execution. It enables team-based AI development through skill-based workflows, terminal dashboard monitoring, queue scheduling, and visual workflow editing for complex collaborative projects.

repos.description: ✨ The open-source multi-agent platform. Every agent gets its own computer, desktop, network, and long-term memory.  You can bring your own key, or host your coding agent like Claude Code, Codex and so on.
repos.summary_zh: Memoh 是一个自托管的容器化 AI 智能体平台，支持创建多个具备长期记忆能力的独立机器人。通过 Docker 实现容器级隔离，可连接 Telegram、Discord、Feishu（Lark）、Matrix 等通信渠道，提供图形化配置界面和 MCP 工具调用能力，适用于家庭或团队的多成员协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Memoh is a self-hosted, containerized AI agent platform enabling multiple bots with persistent long-term memory. Each bot runs in isolated containers and integrates with platforms like Telegram, Discord, Feishu (Lark), and Matrix via a web UI, supporting role-based access and cross-platform identity recognition for team or family use.

repos.description: 开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案 | 集成FunASR本地模型和可配置大语言模型的下一代中文桌面语音工作流
repos.summary_zh: 蛐蛐 (QuQu) 是一款开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案，专为中文用户打造的桌面端智能语音工作流工具。集成阿里巴巴 FunASR 本地语音识别模型和可配置大语言模型，实现高精度中文识别与智能文本优化，支持隐私保护、国产 AI 模型适配及开发者友好功能，完全免费且跨平台。
repos.summary_en: QuQu is an open-source, free alternative to Wispr Flow, designed as a next-generation Chinese desktop voice workflow tool. It integrates Alibaba's FunASR local speech recognition model with configurable large language models, enabling high-precision Chinese transcription and intelligent text optimization. Features include privacy protection, support for domestic AI models, and developer-friendly formatting, all completely free and cross-platform.

repos.description: Automatic Panorama Stitching From Scratch
repos.summary_zh: OpenPano 是一个从零开始用 C++ 编写的自动全景拼接程序，无需依赖任何计算机视觉库。它实现了基于不变特征的经典全景拼接算法，支持圆柱面、相机参数估计和平移三种模式，适用于手持相机拍摄的连续图像拼接，输出高质量无缝全景图。
repos.summary_en: OpenPano is a C++-based automatic panorama stitching tool implemented from scratch without external vision libraries. It follows the pipeline from 'Automatic Panoramic Image Stitching using Invariant Features' and supports cylinder, camera estimation, and translation modes for seamless image stitching from handheld captures.

repos.description: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为高权限自主AI代理OpenClaw设计，采用‘代理式零信任架构’范式，从传统静态防御转向动态防护。通过三层防御矩阵（事前行为黑名单、事中权限限制、事后夜间审计）有效应对提示注入、供应链投毒等AI特有风险，支持强推理模型自动部署，显著降低用户配置成本。
repos.summary_en: This guide is tailored for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional static defense to 'Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture'. It implements a battle-tested 3-Tier Defense Matrix—pre-action blacklists, in-action permission controls, and post-action nightly audits—to mitigate LLM-specific threats like prompt injection and supply chain poisoning. Designed for seamless integration with strong reasoning models to minimize manual security setup.

repos.description: A local-first AI chat workspace for models, agents, skills, plugins, search, RAG, voice, memory, and artifacts.

repos.description: 🤖 叮当是一款可以工作在 Raspberry Pi 上的中文语音对话机器人/智能音箱项目。
repos.summary_zh: 叮当是一款专为树莓派设计的开源中文语音对话机器人/智能音箱项目，支持模块化插件扩展、微信远程操控、多平台语音识别与合成技术，并集成智能家居控制功能，旨在帮助中国开发者快速构建个性化智能设备。
repos.summary_en: Dingdang is an open-source Chinese voice dialogue robot/smart speaker project designed for Raspberry Pi, featuring modular plugins, WeChat integration, multi-platform STT/TTS support, and smart home control, enabling developers to easily build personalized voice assistants.

repos.description: 通过对话挖掘用户需求，并自动生成专业的提示词，支持系统/用户提示词优化、效果对比，版本管理和支持即时渲染的操练场，新增通过多轮对话绘图改图，图片逆推提示词、绘图提示词优化，https://yprompt.252035.xyz   公共账号：demo / demo
repos.summary_zh: YPrompt 是一款 AI 驱动的提示词生成与优化工具，通过多轮对话精准挖掘用户需求并自动生成专业系统提示词。支持提示词版本管理、效果对比及即时渲染操练场，新增多轮对话绘图改图、图片逆推提示词、提示词翻译等功能，提供 Linux.do、飞书等多认证方式，适配桌面与移动端响应式设计。
repos.summary_en: YPrompt is an AI-powered prompt generation and optimization tool that uses conversational dialogue to extract user needs and automatically generates professional system prompts. It supports prompt versioning, effect comparison, real-time rendering playground, multi-turn image generation/editing, reverse-prompting from images, and prompt translation. Features multi-auth (Linux.do, Feishu), dual-database support (SQLite/MySQL), and responsive design for desktop/mobile.

repos.description: [GenAI Application Development Framework]  🚀 Build GenAI application quick and easy 💬 Easy to interact with GenAI agent in code using structure data and chained-calls syntax 🧩 Use Event-Driven Flow *TriggerFlow* to manage complex GenAI working logic 🔀 Switch to any model without rewrite application code
repos.summary_zh: Agently 4 是一个生产级 GenAI 应用开发框架，支持结构化数据交互、链式调用语法和事件驱动流（TriggerFlow）编排复杂工作逻辑。它提供契约优先的输出控制、多模型无缝切换能力，并集成会话管理、工具调用与 FastAPI，显著提升 AI 应用的开发效率与稳定性。
repos.summary_en: Agently 4 is a production-grade GenAI application development framework enabling structured data interaction, chained-calls syntax, and event-driven flow orchestration via TriggerFlow. It offers contract-first output control, seamless model switching, session management, tool integration, and FastAPI support to accelerate reliable AI app development.

repos.description: MCP server that provides tools and resources for interacting with n8n API
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供了一个基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的服务器，使 AI 助手能够通过自然语言与 n8n 工作流自动化平台进行交互。核心功能包括通过 API 管理 n8n 工作流、触发执行、获取状态等，支持 Docker 部署和 npm 安装，适用于 AI 驱动的流程自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides an MCP server enabling AI assistants to interact with n8n workflows via natural language. It allows programmatic management of n8n workflows and executions through its API, supporting deployment via npm or Docker. Key use cases include AI-driven workflow automation and integration.

repos.description: AI 写作伙伴，点亮你的创作灵感
repos.summary_zh: Arboris-Novel 是一款面向创作者的 AI 写作辅助工具，通过角色管理、大纲生成和智能续写功能帮助解决创作卡顿问题。支持多版本内容对比与个性化风格适配，旨在打造能理解角色、记忆世界设定的智能写作伙伴，提供 Docker 快速部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Arboris-Novel is an AI-powered writing assistant for creators, featuring character management, outline generation, and intelligent content continuation. It supports multi-version comparison and personalized style adaptation to create a smart writing companion that remembers your world and understands characters, with Docker-based deployment.

repos.description: 搜索真实文献并生成引用对应文献的AI论文
repos.summary_zh: paper-ai 是一个基于 AI 的论文写作工具，支持通过真实文献自动生成引用，集成 Semantic Scholar、arXiv 和 PubMed 进行文献检索，结合大模型生成高质量学术内容，显著提升论文撰写效率与引用准确性。
repos.summary_en: Paper-ai is an AI-powered academic writing tool that generates papers with real citations by searching Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and PubMed. It combines large language models with academic databases to streamline research and writing workflows.

repos.description: Google Assistant for macOS!
repos.summary_zh: MacAssistant 是一款将 Google Assistant 集成到 macOS 的 Swift 应用，支持语音交互与系统控制。通过 Google Assistant SDK 实现自然语言处理，支持天气查询、日程管理等常见指令，需用户自行配置 OAuth 凭证。项目采用 Swift 4.2 开发，基于 gRPC 和 Protocol Buffers，提供跨平台语音助手解决方案。
repos.summary_en: MacAssistant is a Swift-based macOS app integrating Google Assistant via the Google Assistant SDK, enabling voice interaction and system control. It supports natural language queries like weather and agenda, requiring user-provided OAuth credentials. Built with Swift 4.2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers, it offers a cross-platform voice assistant solution for macOS.

repos.description: A Python library that provides an easy way to identify devices like mobile phones, tablets and their capabilities by parsing (browser) user agent strings.
repos.summary_zh: user_agents 是一个 Python 库，用于解析浏览器 User-Agent 字符串，精准识别设备类型（手机、平板、PC）及其功能特性（如触屏能力），支持主流移动平台与爬虫检测，依赖 ua-parser 实现高效解析。
repos.summary_en: user_agents is a Python library that parses browser User-Agent strings to accurately identify device types (mobile, tablet, PC) and capabilities (e.g., touch support), supporting major platforms and bot detection via the ua-parser engine.

repos.description: 这是一个基于Claude Skill的**AI人像Prompt生成系统**，能够从特征库中智能组合生成高质量的人像描述Prompt，并具备自动学习和库扩展能力。 核心能力: Prompt生成、特征提取、自动学习、智能审核、版本控制
repos.summary_zh: 基于Claude Skills的AI人像Prompt生成系统，集成12个专业领域Skills与1246+元素库，支持Portrait/Cross-Domain/Design三种智能生成模式。具备语义理解、跨域组合、变量采样等核心能力，提供自动学习、智能审核和版本控制功能，实现从特征提取到高质量提示词生成的全流程自动化。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered prompt generation system based on Claude Skills, integrating 12 domain-specific skills with a 1,246+ element library. Supports three intelligent modes: Portrait, Cross-Domain, and Design. Features semantic understanding, cross-domain composition, variable sampling, automatic learning, intelligent review, and version control for end-to-end automated prompt generation.

repos.description: MultiAgentPPT 是一个集成了 A2A（Agent2Agent）+ MCP（Model Context Protocol）+ ADK（Agent Development Kit） 架构的智能化演示文稿生成系统，支持通过多智能体协作和流式并发机制
repos.summary_zh: MultiAgentPPT 是基于 A2A+MCP+ADK 架构的多智能体演示文稿生成系统，通过大纲生成、主题拆分、并行调研和流式汇总等智能体协作，实现高质量PPT的自动化生成，支持实时编辑与下载，具备可扩展性和本地模型适配能力。
repos.summary_en: MultiAgentPPT is a multi-agent system leveraging A2A+MCP+ADK architecture to automate PPT generation through outline creation, topic splitting, parallel research, and streaming synthesis. It supports real-time editing, high-quality content, extensibility, and local model compatibility.

repos.summary_en: AutoAgents is an open-source framework for automatically generating collaborative multi-agent systems based on LLMs to tackle complex tasks. It features a planner, observers, tools, and dynamically generated expert agents with reflection mechanisms. Applications include rumor verification and game automation. The associated paper was accepted at IJCAI 2024.

repos.description: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文辅助创作系统，解决 AI 写作中的「遗忘」和「幻觉」问题，支持 200 万字量级 连载创作。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文创作辅助系统，通过双 Agent 架构和六维审查机制解决 AI 写作中的遗忘与幻觉问题，支持 200 万字级连载创作，集成 RAG 检索、创意约束系统和追读力机制，确保叙事连贯性与读者粘性。
repos.summary_en: A long-form webnovel writing assistant built on Claude Code, utilizing dual-agent architecture and six-dimensional review mechanisms to address AI writing issues like forgetting and hallucination, supporting serialized creation up to 2 million words with RAG retrieval, creative constraint systems, and reader engagement mechanics.

repos.description: Browser action engine for AI agents. 10× faster, resilient by design.
repos.summary_zh: Actionbook 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的浏览器操作引擎，提供实时更新的网页操作手册和 DOM 结构信息，使智能体能快速、精准地执行网页交互任务。相比传统方法，其性能提升 10 倍，显著降低 LLM 的 token 消耗，并通过语义化 JSON 定义实现高容错性和跨框架兼容性。
repos.summary_en: Actionbook is a browser action engine designed for AI agents, delivering up-to-date action manuals and DOM structure so agents can instantly operate any website without guessing. It enables 10x faster execution, 100x token savings, resilient automation via versioned manuals, and universal compatibility with any LLM or agent framework.

repos.description: Agent-native AI assistant — chat, write, whiteboard, learning, all in one.
repos.summary_zh: YOLO 是一款专为 Obsidian 设计的智能 AI 助手插件，支持 Agent 模式、多窗口对话和知识库问答。通过工具调用与自定义技能实现自动化操作，结合 RAG 技术将整个知识库作为上下文，提供多语言、多模型支持的流畅写作与任务处理体验。
repos.summary_en: YOLO is an intelligent, multilingual AI assistant plugin for Obsidian, featuring Agent mode with tool calling and custom skills, multi-window chat, RAG-powered knowledge base Q&A, and seamless integration with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and other mainstream LLMs.

repos.description: A more beautiful and easier-to-use alternative to OpenClaw. It features a nicer Web UI, built-in IM support, a sandboxed runtime and channel-based team collaboration. Under the hood, it is powered by a Claude Code–based agent.
repos.summary_zh: Poco 是一款基于 Claude Code 的智能体平台，提供比 OpenClaw 更美观易用的替代方案。核心特性包括安全沙箱环境、多模态文件支持、原生 Claude Code 交互体验（计划模式/提问模式）、内置浏览器与 GitHub 集成、MCP/Skills 扩展能力，以及钉钉/飞书/Telegram 消息集成。采用 Next.js + FastAPI 架构，支持 Docker 一键部署和移动端访问。
repos.summary_en: Poco is a safer and more user-friendly alternative to OpenClaw, powered by a Claude Code-based agent. It features a secure sandboxed runtime, native Claude Code experience (Plan Mode, AskQuestion), built-in browser, GitHub integration, MCP/Skills extensibility, IM integrations (DingTalk/Feishu/Telegram), and multilingual support. Built with Next.js + FastAPI, deployable via Docker with mobile access.

repos.description: Desktop Agent for Any Task
repos.summary_zh: WorkAny 是一款桌面 AI 智能体应用，通过自然语言指令执行复杂任务，支持实时代码生成、工具调用和沙箱环境运行。基于 Claude Agent SDK 构建，集成 MCP 协议与多模型供应商，提供文件管理、文档/网页/表格/幻灯片生成等全场景能力，适用于自动化办公与软件开发。
repos.summary_en: WorkAny is a desktop AI agent that executes tasks via natural language, featuring real-time code generation, sandboxed execution, and workspace management. Built on Claude Agent SDK with MCP support and multi-provider LLM integration, it enables automated file organization, document/web/table/slide generation, and software development workflows.

repos.description: OpenAI-compatible API for Gemini Business with multi-account load balancing and multimodal capabilities (image/video generation, file parsing) | 将 Gemini Business 转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡及多模态能力（图像生成、视频生成、解析文件）
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Business2API 将 Gemini Business 转换为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡、自动化注册登录、多模态文件解析（100+格式）、图像/视频生成及流式输出。提供 Docker 部署、管理面板和 PostgreSQL/SQLite 存储，适用于个人技术研究与非商业场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Business2API converts Gemini Business into an OpenAI-compatible API with multi-account load balancing, automated account management, multimodal file parsing (100+ formats), image/video generation, and streaming responses. Features Docker deployment, admin panel, and PostgreSQL/SQLite persistence for non-commercial research use.

repos.description: ❤️‍🔥 A chrome extension as an alternative to Notion AI that goes beyond Notion AI. | 一个替代 Notion AI 的浏览器插件，不止于 Notion AI
repos.summary_zh: Writely 是一款基于 OpenAI GPT 模型的浏览器插件，旨在替代 Notion AI。它支持在任意网页编辑器中提供智能写作辅助、邮件撰写、文章创作及社交媒体互动等功能，显著提升用户的内容创作效率与质量，实现跨平台的智能文本处理体验。
repos.summary_en: Writely is a browser extension powered by OpenAI's GPT model, designed as an alternative to Notion AI. It enables intelligent writing assistance across any webpage editor, supporting email composition, article drafting, and social media interactions, thereby enhancing content creation efficiency and quality with cross-platform accessibility.

repos.description: 把灵感、写作、出图、改稿、沉淀放进同一个工作台，让创作从“想到”直接走到“可发布”
repos.summary_zh: ProxyCast 是一个面向创作者的 AI Agent 平台，整合灵感发散、内容生成、素材制作与版本沉淀全流程，支持社媒、短视频、小说、海报等九大创作主题，实现从想法到可发布内容的一站式高效创作。
repos.summary_en: ProxyCast is an AI Agent platform for creators, integrating ideation, content generation, asset creation, and versioning into a unified workspace. It supports nine major creative domains—from social media to novels—enabling seamless workflows from concept to publishable output.

repos.description: Bringing together outstanding artificial intelligence (AI) open source projects from around the world.

repos.description: A diffusion model to colorize black and white images
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用扩散模型对黑白图像进行自动着色，采用LAB颜色空间分离亮度与色彩通道，仅对色彩通道添加噪声并预测去噪结果。模型基于UNet架构，结合灰度图像特征进行条件控制，实现端到端的图像着色。项目展示了从噪声生成彩色图像的过程，适用于历史影像修复、老照片上色等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project implements a diffusion model for automatic colorization of black-and-white images using the LAB color space, where only the color channels are noised and predicted. The UNet-based model conditions on grayscale features and predicts denoised color channels, enabling end-to-end image colorization. It's suitable for restoring historical photos and enhancing old images.

With 400+ integrations, native AI agent workflows via LangChain, and a fair-code license, it supports self-hosting or cloud deployment, featuring enterprise-grade permissions, SSO, and multi-database compatibility for complex automation.

repos.summary_en: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI agent framework enabling rapid development of modular agents. With just a few lines of code, users can build agents with tools, knowledge retrieval, memory, MCP protocol, and more, ideal for Web3 automation, multi-agent collaboration, and advanced AI workflows.

repos.summary_en: NovelClaw is a dynamic-memory-first collaborative AI framework for long-form story generation, transforming writing into an inspectable workspace with chapter planning, character/worldview management, memory banks, and manuscript review for coherent narrative creation.

repos.description: Local-first multi-AI group chat desktop app — pull gpt, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek into one conversation. Tauri 2 + React 19.

repos.summary_en: Talkio is a local-first multi-AI group chat desktop app that integrates models like GPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek into one conversation. Built with Tauri 2 + React 19, it features persona-based roleplay, MCP tool integration, file parsing, streaming output, and cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux/Android), with all data encrypted locally in SQLite for privacy.

repos.description: 一个用于重新生成 Cursor 设备 ID 和设置 Access Token 的 Cursor 扩展

Supports Cursor 0.45.x-0.46.x, featuring usage monitoring, config backup, and cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux).

repos.summary_en: Voxt is a macOS menu bar app for voice input and translation, featuring global hotkey recording, real-time waveform display, multi-engine speech recognition (local MLX and remote ASR), text enhancement, and clipboard-safe auto-paste. It supports transcription, translation, selected-text processing, and history management with configurable providers.

repos.description: Battle-tested Claude Code workflow template — memory management, context engineering, and task routing from 3 months of daily usage
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个经过实战检验的 Claude Code 工作流模板，提供内存管理、上下文工程和任务路由三大核心能力。基于3个月多项目日常使用经验构建，采用三层架构设计：常驻规则层、按需文档层和热数据工作区，实现智能持久化开发伙伴。支持多模型分级路由、自动保存进度、强制验证完成状态，显著提升开发效率与代码质量。
repos.summary_en: A battle-tested Claude Code workflow template featuring memory management, context engineering, and task routing from 3 months of daily usage. Implements a three-layer architecture: always-loaded rules, on-demand docs, and hot working memory. Enables persistent, self-improving development with multi-model routing, auto-save, verification gates, and cross-session task tracking for production-ready workflows.

repos.description: A modular skill-based framework for writing, revising, and managing LaTeX academic papers with AI assistance.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于模块化技能框架的 LaTeX 学术论文 AI 辅助写作系统，支持从选题到生成 PDF 的全流程自动化。核心功能包括文献调研、创新点挖掘、实验设计、结果回填和文本润色，集成 GPT-5.2/5.4 与 Claude/Gemini 多智能体协作，提供严格的 gated workflow 确保学术严谨性。
repos.summary_en: A modular skill-based framework for AI-assisted academic writing in LaTeX, enabling end-to-end paper generation from topic to compiled PDF. Features include literature synthesis, experimental design, result backfilling, prose refinement, and multi-agent collaboration with GPT-5.x and Claude/Gemini. Enforces gated workflows for academic rigor.

repos.summary_en: L3AGI is an open-source framework enabling AI agents to collaborate as effectively as human teams. It supports autonomous AI assistants with memory, multi-data source integration (PostgreSQL, MySQL, VectorDB), and LlamaIndex, ideal for complex task automation and team-based workflows.

repos.description: 🧠 Cortex - Universal AI Agent Memory Service
repos.summary_zh: Cortex 是一个开源的通用 AI 智能体记忆服务，通过三层动态内存生命周期（工作记忆→核心记忆→归档）实现长期记忆管理。结合 Neo4j 知识图谱与混合搜索（BM25+向量+LLM重排），支持多智能体隔离命名空间、自托管部署及 MCP 协议集成，确保数据主权与低成本运行。

It combines Neo4j knowledge graphs with hybrid search (BM25 + vectors + LLM reranking), supports multi-agent namespaces, self-hosting via Docker, and MCP integration, ensuring data ownership and low-cost operation.

repos.description: 使用Claude Code，Cursor, codex, gemini 写微信公众号文章工具。
repos.summary_zh: Article Writer 是一款专为微信公众号/自媒体设计的 AI 智能写作系统，集成 Claude、Cursor、Gemini 等 13 个 AI 助手平台。通过九步写作流程与四大多模式创作体系（教练/快速/混合/框架约束），结合素材库、文档爬虫与三遍审校机制，帮助用户产出高真实性、低 AI 检测率的内容，核心目标是保留人类真实表达与个性化细节。
repos.summary_en: Article Writer is an AI-powered intelligent writing system designed for WeChat Official Accounts and self-media content. Integrated with 13 AI assistants including Claude, Cursor, and Gemini, it features a 9-step writing workflow and four multi-mode creation systems (Coach/Quick/Hybrid/Outline-constrained). With material libraries, document crawlers, and triple-review mechanisms, it helps users produce highly authentic content with low AI detection rates, preserving human voice and personal details.

repos.description: 灵匠 - AI 驱动的创意内容生成平台，支持 AI 图像生成、视频生成、角色项目管理、可视化工作流编辑等功能。

repos.summary_en: SoulArtisan is an AI-powered creative content generation platform featuring text-to-image, image-to-video, and character management. Built with Spring Boot and React, it offers visual workflow editing via node-based design for end-to-end creation from scripts to videos, complete with point systems and cloud storage for production use.

repos.description: 这是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 项目，它充当一个代理服务器，能够将 Claude API 格式的请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式。这使得任何与 Claude API 兼容的客户端（例如官方的 @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI）都能够与任何支持 OpenAI API 格式的服务进行通信，如 Google Gemini, Groq, Ollama 等。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 代理服务器，可将 Claude API 请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式，支持动态路由至 Google Gemini、Groq、Ollama 等兼容服务，具备全功能 API 兼容、函数调用转换、Haiku 模型快捷配置及一键部署脚本，实现 Claude 客户端与多 AI 服务的无缝互通。
repos.summary_en: This is a TypeScript project deployed on Cloudflare Workers that acts as a proxy server, seamlessly converting Claude API requests to OpenAI API format. It enables any Claude-compatible client (e.g., @anthropic-ai/claude-code) to communicate with OpenAI-compatible services like Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama via dynamic routing, full API compatibility, tool calling conversion, and one-click deployment.

repos.summary_en: ZAI/GLM TTS is a free text-to-speech API based on Zhipu AI's TTS technology, supporting voice cloning and multiple built-in voices. It offers an OpenAI-compatible interface deployable via Docker, CLI, or Home Assistant, ideal for smart assistants and automation use cases.
