repos.summary_en: SeekMoney-ai is an intelligent business opportunity discovery tool that collects data from 8 major social media platforms (Douyin, TikTok, Bilibili, etc.), uses GLM-4.7 with DBSCAN clustering to analyze user pain points, provides a three-dimensional scoring system for demand intensity, market size, and competition, and generates MVP proposals to help entrepreneurs identify market opportunities.

repos.summary_en: Generates complete workflow definition files (Coze/Dify/ComfyUI compatible) from natural language descriptions, including node configuration, connections, layout, and platform-specific formats for complex use cases like financial reports and video generation.

repos.summary_en: Nya AI is an integrated collaborative platform combining AI chat, web search, note-taking, document writing, team communication, and cloud storage. repos.summary_en: SpexFlow is a visual context/spec workflow tool built on React Flow for orchestrating codebase context and specifications for AI agents. Powered by prompt engineering, it enables creative modes (poetry, rudeness) and meta-functions (prompt writing). Automated features handle math, file parsing, and screenshots, while proactive tools include web search, code execution, and browser automation—all reflecting a clear separation between deterministic logic and AI creativity.

repos.summary_zh: 该仓库构建了一个基于 Claude Code 智能体的社交媒体深度研究系统，结合 Web Search 与 TikHub API 实现多平台数据采集。通过并行子智能体架构，支持对 TikTok、微博、知乎等14+平台进行跨文化影响力分析，自动生成带引用的结构化研究报告，适用于品牌监测、舆情分析及人物影响力评估。
repos.summary_en: This repository implements a social media research system using Claude Code agents integrated with TikHub API for multi-platform data collection. It employs parallel sub-agents to analyze 14+ platforms like TikTok and Weibo, generating structured reports with citations for cross-cultural influence studies, brand monitoring, and public figure impact assessments.

repos.description: Ollama to OpenAI compatible API gateway — multi-backend load balancing, health check, auto discovery
repos.summary_zh: Ollama2API 是一个将多个 Ollama 实例聚合为统一 OpenAI 兼容 API 的网关，支持多节点负载均衡、自动健康检查与批量扫描发现。提供 Web 管理后台、API Key 鉴权、代理集成及流式响应，零依赖 JSON 存储，适用于 AI 模型集群管理与自动化运维。
repos.summary_en: Ollama2API is a gateway that aggregates multiple Ollama instances into a unified OpenAI-compatible API, featuring multi-node load balancing, automatic health checks, and batch node discovery. It includes a web admin panel, API key authentication, proxy support, and streaming responses, using zero-dependency JSON storage for easy deployment in AI model cluster management.

repos.description: A battle-tested two-layer memory system for AI agents that need to remember across sessions.
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Memory Architecture 是一套经过实战验证的 AI Agent 长期记忆系统，解决跨会话失忆问题。采用双层文件架构（热缓存 MEMORY.md + 深度存储 memory/），结合确定性查找与语义搜索检索协议，通过 Supersede 机制追踪事实演变，并引入程序职员模式自动沉淀知识。所有数据以 Markdown+JSON 格式存储，Git 友好且透明可控，确保在嵌入服务不可用时仍具备 90% 日常场景的零依赖检索能力。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw Memory Architecture is a battle-tested two-layer memory system for AI agents requiring cross-session recall. It features a hot cache (MEMORY.md) and deep storage (memory/) with deterministic lookup and semantic search protocols, Supersede mechanism for fact evolution tracking, and a 'program clerk' process for automated knowledge proposal with human review. Built on Git-friendly Markdown/JSON, it maintains 90% zero-dependency functionality even when embedding services fail.

repos.description: 一个AI写作平台
repos.summary_zh: do-write 是一个基于 Java 和 Spring AI 的 AI 驱动小说创作平台，提供从世界观构建、角色设计到大纲规划和章节生成的全流程智能写作向导。核心亮点包括 RAG 增强的上下文感知写作、ChromaDB 故事记忆系统保持剧情连贯性，支持 OpenAI/Ollama/DashScope 等多模型接入，并具备 Docker 一键部署能力。
repos.summary_en: Do-Write is an AI-powered novel writing platform built with Java and Spring AI, offering end-to-end creative guidance from world-building to chapter generation. Key features include RAG-enhanced contextual writing, ChromaDB-based story memory for plot continuity, multi-model support (OpenAI/Ollama/DashScope), and Docker Compose deployment. The system combines intelligent prompts with vectorized narrative recall.

repos.description: 一个划词ai助手，支持横向深入
repos.summary_zh: askanywhere 是一款划词 AI 助手，支持横向深入提问与嵌套问答，具备笔记记录、行为记忆、RAG 增强回答及艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线复习功能。通过悬浮窗口实现非侵入式交互，自动识别用户意图并提供翻译、代码解释、文本修正等智能服务，打造个性化私人 AI 助手。
repos.summary_en: AskAnywhere is a smart text-selection AI assistant enabling nested, multi-turn queries via floating windows. It features note-taking with auto-tagging, behavior logging, RAG-enhanced responses, and spaced repetition review based on the Ebbinghaus curve. Designed for seamless interaction, it intelligently detects intent—translation, code explanation, or text correction—and integrates into daily workflows.

repos.description: 油猴 chatgpt Prompt 脚本插件，在chatgpt聊天框导入Prompt 对话框
repos.summary_zh: 该油猴脚本为 ChatGPT 网页端提供中文 Prompt 训练对话框插件，支持一键导入预设角色提示词，提升交互效率。基于 GreasyFork 部署，集成 Docusaurus 搜索功能并优化 PC 端中文输入延迟问题。强调使用英文提示词以获得更稳定输出，建议添加 'respond in Chinese' 控制回复语言。
repos.summary_en: A Tampermonkey script that adds a Chinese Prompt training dialog to ChatGPT's web interface, enabling one-click import of role-based prompts for enhanced productivity. Hosted on GreasyFork with Docusaurus-powered search, it addresses PC-side input lag via debounce. Recommends English prompts for reliability and supports language control via 'respond in Chinese'.

repos.description: This is a simple ollama admin panel that implements a list of models to download models and a dialog function.
repos.summary_zh: Ollama Manager 是一个简洁的 Ollama 模型管理面板，支持模型列表展示、搜索与下载功能，并提供基础对话交互界面。基于 Wails 框架开发，采用 GoEasyDesigner 设计界面，提供 Windows 和 macOS 跨平台支持，适用于本地大模型部署与管理的轻量化工具。
repos.summary_en: Ollama Manager is a lightweight admin panel for managing Ollama models, featuring model listing, search, download, and basic chat functionality. Built with Wails and designed via GoEasyDesigner, it supports cross-platform deployment on Windows and macOS, serving as an efficient local tool for LLM deployment and interaction.

repos.description: Codex loves Outlook... stable and for free
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用指纹浏览器（如BitBrowser）结合Outlook邮箱，实现稳定免费的Codex账号注册与使用，专为Windows系统设计。通过分离注册与登录流程，并利用refresh_token机制保障账号长期可用，实测5天内无封号记录。适合个人开发者高频调用，但功能稳定性受OpenAI策略影响较大。
repos.summary_en: This project enables stable, free Codex account registration and usage via fingerprint browsers (e.g., BitBrowser) with Outlook emails on Windows. It separates registration and login processes, leveraging refresh tokens for persistent access without bans. Tested successfully for 5 days with zero account kills, ideal for personal developers despite potential instability due to OpenAI's evolving policies.

repos.description: 在 tmux 中管理交互式 Claude Code agent，并在 kitty 中协调不同 code agent 的可见协作与接力
repos.summary_zh: CCM Orchestra 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的控制平面，通过 tmux 实现持久化交互式代理会话管理，并利用 kitty 提供可视化协作与消息中继功能。该系统采用分层架构：tmux 层负责会话生命周期管理与工作目录隔离，kitty 层支持多代理可见协作与接力通信，形成可观测、可复用的 AI 编程协作模型。
repos.summary_en: CCM Orchestra is a control plane for managing persistent, interactive Claude Code agents in tmux while enabling visible collaboration between code agents through kitty. It features a two-layer architecture: the tmux layer maintains reusable agent sessions with worktree isolation, while the kitty layer provides human-observable coordination and message relay capabilities, forming a paired operating model for parallel AI-assisted development workflows.

Delivered as a standalone executable JAR for desktop use.

repos.description: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
repos.summary_en: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.

repos.description: english-chunks，英语块学习法，通过 AI 联系英文发音，实现口语快速提升。
repos.summary_zh: English Chunks 是一款基于 AI 的英语口语学习工具，通过从 YouTube 视频中提取地道英语表达（chunks），结合磨耳式重复播放训练，帮助用户自然习得发音与用法。项目完全由 Cursor 生成，支持一键 Vercel 部署，致力于探索 AI 辅助语言学习的创新路径。
repos.summary_en: English Chunks is an AI-powered English speaking learning app that extracts authentic English chunks from YouTube videos and uses repetitive listening (ear training) to help users naturally acquire pronunciation and usage. Built entirely with Cursor, it supports one-click Vercel deployment and aims to explore innovative AI-assisted language learning methods.
